The '''Bruvia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Harron Marches/Legends|Harron Marches]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Bruvian]] social group.<ref name="MSI" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bruvia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-11.<ref name="TEA" />
